changes: Create initial Home Assistant HACS integration scaffold and repository documentation.
Define the Phase 1 standalone thermostat contract, actuator confirmation, safety recovery, lifecycle behavior, and acceptance criteria.
Align the main specification with current Home Assistant enum, valve action, and custom translation conventions.
Implement standalone and multi-zone Config Flow with room count and ordered switch/temperature pairs.
Validate live entity states and prevent duplicate switches across rooms, entries, and active flows.
Add English/Korean forms, configuration-only lifecycle hooks, and 12 boundary tests; actual heating runtime and HA frontend validation remain pending.
Save pre-change files under .git/backups because Git author and remote are not configured.
Implement standalone Climate with hysteresis, minimum ON/OFF times, report freshness and recovery, overheat and manual-override latches.
Add confirmed switch commands, bounded OFF retries, OFF preemption, safe unload, persistent intent and exclusive runtime ownership.
Add control options and pass 50 automated tests on Windows Python 3.14.5; live HA heating validation remains pending.
Record user confirmation that the prior standalone Config Flow works in HA; keep multi-zone runtime deferred.
Register the standalone software thermostat as a service device through Climate DeviceInfo with a stable config-entry identifier.
Use primary-entity naming and preserve the existing Climate unique ID; adapt the existing HA boundary doubles for device metadata imports.
Document device visibility; live HA device registry verification remains pending.
Raise the standalone Climate target temperature minimum from 5°C to 18°C while keeping the maximum at 30°C and step at 0.1°C.
Align controller validation and Korean user documentation with the 18–30°C target range.
Implement bounded in-memory temperature history, regression slope, confirmed heater-cycle observation, response delay, and post-OFF peak/coast detection.
Expose five Korean/English diagnostic sensors attached to the standalone thermostat device; observations do not affect controller decisions or heater commands.
Document Phase 2 data limits, interruption handling, and acceptance criteria; learned parameters and predictive control remain deferred.

Learn heating response delay, heating rate, residual rise, and post-heating peak delay from completed Phase 2 cycles with per-metric EWMA, range validation, and outlier rejection after a three-sample baseline.
Track per-metric variance/sample counts and confidence; expose learned estimates, confidence, and accepted/rejected cycle plus rejected metric diagnostics.
Persist validated thermal aggregates under a separate per-entry Store key, restore safely after restart, and remove on config-entry deletion; predictive control remains disconnected.
Add Phase 3 design and acceptance documentation; pass 62 automated tests. Live Home Assistant verification remains pending.
Add a persistent, OFF-by-default Auto Control switch to the standalone thermostat device.
Make OFF an observation-only handover that stops an actively controlled heater once, then learns from externally operated cycles without taking actuator ownership.
When enabled in Climate HEAT mode, add a confidence-weighted learned residual cutoff and restart guard while preserving minimum-on/off, sensor, fault, and actuator-confirmation behavior.
Add English/Korean entity names, update Phase 4 design and usage documentation, and validate the Home Assistant SwitchEntity contract against the official developer docs.
Pass 66 automated tests after updating runtime platform boundary doubles; live HA and physical temperature behavior remain to be checked by the user.
Serialize runtime startup because Climate and Auto Control entities can both start the shared runtime during platform setup.
Add a concurrent-start regression test; pass 67 automated tests. Live HA startup and fresh-temperature availability remain to be validated by the user.
Assign semantic Home Assistant device classes to duration and temperature-delta diagnostics, and total-increasing state classes to cumulative cycle/rejection counters.
Add explicit metric-specific icons for all thirteen diagnostic sensors; leave device class unset for temperature-rate and learning-confidence metrics without matching standard classes.
Add a metadata regression test and document the sensor semantics; pass 68 automated tests.
Implement optional predictive ON using the recent validated cooling slope and the confidence-weighted learned heating response delay.
Keep startup, sensor, fault, HVAC-mode, minimum-OFF and actuator-confirmation guards; schedule minimum-ON reevaluation before predictive cutoff.
Add early-start and minimum timer boundary tests; pass 71 automated tests. Live HA and physical heating response remain to be checked by the user.
Replace the separate Auto Control switch with built-in Climate OFF/HEAT/AUTO modes; HEAT uses hysteresis and AUTO adds learned predictive control.
Add built-in HOME/AWAY presets with configurable 23°C/18°C defaults and persisted selection/target.
Migrate legacy saved heat plus Auto Control switch state to HEAT or AUTO, and preserve late-ON safety recovery during OFF transitions.
Update translations, runtime/options, phase specifications, README and tree; pass 73 automated tests. Live HA frontend and physical heating behavior remain pending.
Add Korean system architecture documentation for OFF/HEAT/AUTO learning policy, thermal observation flow, EWMA confidence, predictive ON/OFF, safety ordering, storage, and implementation modules.
Link the architecture document from README and update the documented project tree.
Complete the HACS integration manifest with the requested 0.1.0 version, owner, documentation, issue tracker, helper type, and calculated IoT class.
Add HACS repository and Home Assistant custom integration brand icons; document HACS custom-repository installation and remaining live HA validation.
Initialize the thermostat controller from an existing valid temperature sensor state so restart alone does not make Climate unavailable.
Accept numeric temperature states marked restored; keep unknown/unavailable or invalid sensor values unavailable and update README startup behavior.
Add startup availability and invalid-temperature regression coverage; pass 75 automated tests.
Preserve cancelled-ON protection across repeated OFF reports and unknown heater states until a real ON-to-OFF transition or explicit control resumption.
Make AUTO reselection non-disruptive and reapply configured HOME/AWAY temperatures on explicit preset reselection.
Limit residual restart waiting to an observed coast, anchor the prediction to its OFF temperature, and schedule reevaluation at the learned peak-delay deadline.
Pass 81 automated tests including six new regression cases; update public README and local architecture/specification notes.
Classify the thermostat integration as device instead of helper to restore its intended placement in Home Assistant.
Temperature-control UI or actuator failure reported by the user remains pending live-state diagnosis; metadata reclassification alone is not evidence of a control fix.
Use Home Assistant's current valid numeric temperature state for climate availability and control regardless of report age.
Limit the configured sensor report-gap timeout to continuity of thermal learning observations; repeated cached reads do not create learning samples.
Clarify sensor availability and report-gap behavior in README and local architecture specifications.
Set the default heating-start and heating-stop temperature offsets to 0.5°C each while retaining independent Config Options Flow adjustment from 0.1°C to 2.0°C.
Clarify both offset directions in Korean and English labels and document the 23°C target thresholds.
Verify default hysteresis start at target minus 0.5°C and stop at target plus 0.5°C, and update baseline test coverage to 82 passing cases.
Add an independently configurable HEAT-mode stop offset defaulting to 0°C while retaining the 0.5°C AUTO stop offset and common 0.5°C start offset.
Update both language labels, option validation, documentation, and mode-specific controller regression coverage.
Add integrated multi-room setup with 2–32 room switches and one shared indoor temperature sensor, creating one Climate and thermal learning runtime.
Command and confirm all group switches together; mixed/unavailable states fault, request group OFF, and do not complete learning cycles. Reserve every switch across Config Entries.
Keep legacy multi_zone entries inert without guessing a shared sensor; update translations, public README, local architecture/specification, and flow/runtime tests.

Split setup and options forms into ordered heating settings, occupancy preset temperatures, and optional outdoor/supply/return sensor pages followed by a final review; create or update the entry only after confirmation.

Persist initial control settings and optional temperature sensor IDs in ConfigEntry.options, validate all selected temperature entities, and retain saved optional sensor selections during options edits.
Remove obsolete per-room-pair forms from the new Config Flow while preserving legacy stored entries; update translations, public README, local specifications, and Config Flow coverage.
Align documentation with existing optional-sensor heat-loss learning, independent aggregates, model schema 2, and fifteen diagnostics; no runtime logic changes.
Correct mode-specific thresholds, startup defaults, current-state sensor availability, fault recovery and peak-delay usage.
Record 101 passing automated tests on 2026-09-27; live HA acceptance remains pending. Keep development documentation untracked by user instruction.
Use the latest five valid reports for diagnostic/AUTO slope when the latest report interval exceeds five minutes; otherwise retain the 45-minute window.
Regress against actual timestamps and retain minimum three reports/ten-minute span, invalid-input reset, bounded retention and cycle-specific regressions.
Pass 105 automated tests including sparse irregular reports, five-point selection, cadence boundary and invalid-input recovery.
Remove the deprecated run_immediately argument from state_reported subscription while retaining unchanged-report processing; align the event-bus test double with the supported async_listen signature.
Aim AUTO residual cutoff and restart waiting at target plus configured AUTO hot tolerance (23.5C for target 23C and offset 0.5C). Preserve predictive ON and minimum-time rules.
Pass 106 automated tests including default/custom residual target boundaries. Preserve unrelated pre-existing event subscription edits without staging them.
Add seven default-disabled experimental diagnostic sensors for measured/outdoor/blended slopes, outdoor weight, baseline/adjusted predicted temperatures and calculation status.
Keep experiments read-only and outside AUTO decisions; gate stale inputs, active heating/coasts and missing models. Limit heuristic outdoor blend to 50 percent.
Add Korean/English names and usage documentation; pass 110 tests. Preserve pre-existing event subscription changes unstaged.
Add twelve default-disabled independent pipe diagnostic sensors with actual-report histories, time-aligned temperature differences and completed-cycle OFF temperatures/residual results.
Keep pipe observation separate from AUTO and learned control; discard partial cycles across invalid input, restart or ambiguous heater transitions.
Add Korean/English names, usage documentation and tests for irregular reports, missing sensors, cycle completion and command/model isolation.
Collect bounded normalized ON and OFF-to-peak temperature response curves from complete heating cycles, including elapsed time, slope and curvature at OFF.
Persist up to 24 complete response curves in model schema 3, migrate schemas 1 and 2, and use comparable curves for confidence-weighted AUTO cutoff with aggregate residual fallback.
Keep heating rate diagnostic, preserve safety and minimum-time guards, and update specifications and focused verification.
Document restart handling for interrupted learning cycles, restoration of completed models, and possible loss of a pending save on abrupt shutdown in README cautions.
Add README Mermaid diagrams for completed heating-cycle learning and AUTO predictive ON/OFF decision flow.
Document curve fallback, coast waiting, safety gates, and persistence in the current implementation.
Move heating-learning and AUTO ON/OFF Mermaid diagrams from README into a dedicated document under docs.
Leave a short README link and update the local file tree; preserve the existing uncommitted code changes.
Add a persisted AUTO prediction selector with eco, balanced and comfort early-start strength.
Keep predictive residual-heat shutdown active in all three policies and retain existing comfort behavior as default.
Use balanced as the default AUTO prediction mode for new and previously unselected installations; preserve explicitly saved selections.
Use compact entity IDs for single entries and numbered room prefixes when multiple entries are configured.
Remove heater switch entity IDs from new standalone configuration titles.
Align current behavior documentation and AUTO control diagram with the eco/balanced/comfort prediction selector and balanced default.
Document compact entity ID rules, configuration-entry room numbering, selector persistence, and current local verification status.
Add persistent per-entry five-minute standards for cold, warm, predictive warm, and cooling curves with 80/20 accepted-cycle updates.
Add AUTO learning-model selection with existing-model fallback, raw bucket TTL, curve quality diagnostics, and interruption-safe lifecycle handling.
Verify curve AUTO cutoff against target plus stop offset and storage-error fallback.
Keep repeated unchanged target commands from invalidating an active curve; document the expanded local regression check.
Document agreed independent default/curve learning and selected-model AUTO operation, AWAY-duration Cold classification, and pre-decline Peak reporting.
Separate intended speed-based and trajectory-based OFF prediction from current residual-based implementation; record unresolved algorithm details without modifying runtime logic.
Adopt learned post-OFF response for both models: a compact slope/time relationship for the default model and matched post-OFF trajectories for the curve model.
Document predicted-versus-observed Peak validation without allowing the unselected model to command heaters.

Implement independently learned default slope/equivalent-time OFF prediction and measured curve OFF trajectories with supported-state matching, variance confidence gates, cooling-curve predictive ON, and safe fallbacks.
Classify Cold after continuous three-hour AWAY and HOME return, retain interrupted Cold intent across restart, exclude AWAY curve updates, and detect the last pre-decline Peak report.

Preserve old thermal models through schema 4 migration and SQLite standards through additive schema 2 migration; keep bounded OFF profiles beyond raw TTL and expose durable completed Peak comparisons.

Update current behavior documentation and retain the imported design draft as a labelled roadmap; pass 156 Windows automated tests including retroactive cooling bucket timestamp preservation, syntax compilation, UTF-8/no-BOM checks, and development JSONL validation.

Add independent Current and Long-term memories for all four curve types and condition-specific OFF trajectories; update Current at 0.2 and promote only stable qualified Current into Long-term at 0.02.

Measure EWMA variance and independent evidence counts; require contiguous coverage, decay Current recency over 30 days, preserve seasonal Long-term, and blend coherent OFF curves with one confidence weight.

Atomically persist schema-3 curve memories while preserving schema-1/2 data, duplicate idempotency and raw TTL; retain validated Current if Long-term is corrupt and expose actual memory source and diagnostics.

Verify learned Long-term is used in actual AUTO ON/OFF after a non-heating season; update current behavior documentation and local file tree; pass 175 Windows automated tests, syntax compilation, UTF-8/no-BOM checks and git diff whitespace validation.
Observe heating response through post-OFF delay and confirm Peak only after measured sustained cooling, preserving real peak timestamps and retroactive held cooling buckets.

Learn delayed low/negative-slope OFF responses using comparable duration, start temperature, ON displacement, pre-ON slope and preceding OFF duration; use direct measured rise in the basic model and signed post-OFF trajectories in curve Current/Long-term memory.
Preserve valid immediate zero-coast responses, unknown conditions and long-term-only context; migrate thermal schema 1-4 to 5 and SQLite schema 1-3 to 4 without resetting learned data.
Prioritize matched OFF forecasts over predictive ON, release waiting on substantial unexpected cooling or forecast expiry, and confine aggregate waiting to legacy models without OFF response data.

Verify 188 Windows tests including actual AUTO OFF and delayed restart waiting under both models, initial dips, isolated reversals, no-response timeouts, schema migration, raw TTL and seasonal memory; update operation documents without changing the external release version.
Add eight recorder-friendly read-only diagnostics for basic/curve confirmed OFF peak forecasts, actual Peak, signed errors, prediction confidence, observation phase and prediction availability.

Retain confirmed OFF predictions and confidence with stable wall-clock cycle metadata; restore historical diagnostics without restarting incomplete control waits and isolate corrupt optional forecast data from valid thermostat intent.
Record actual completed Peak even without forecasts, never compare retained predictions with another cycle, and distinguish basic average learning confidence from per-prediction confidence.

Keep existing entity identifiers and registry choices; enable 15 core sensors by default on new installs while moving eight detailed diagnostics to disabled defaults and retaining 19 disabled experimental sensors; clarify indoor metrics in pipe experiment names.
Document graph layout, cycle timestamps and confidence semantics; verify 194 Windows tests, syntax/JSON/UTF-8 validation and diff whitespace checks; preserve external version 0.1.0.
Replace both brand icons with the selected circular smart thermostat design in off-white, light gray, navy and coral orange.
Keep matching 256x256 RGBA PNG assets with transparent exterior backgrounds; preserve external release version 0.1.0.
Register a shared HA sidebar panel through the internal HTTP server with a locally served JavaScript custom element.
Implement the approved top navigation and operation-first dashboard shell, responsive empty sections and keyboard-accessible tabs without connecting data or heater commands.
Pass 196 Windows tests, syntax/UTF-8/JSON/diff checks, CLI static-file retrieval and Edge browser checks for tab/keyboard/mobile-menu interactions and widths 320/360/700/1024.
Preserve external version 0.1.0; actual HA frontend acceptance remains pending.

Connect the sidebar dashboard to HA's authenticated entity registry and pushed Climate states with read-only room selection, temperature, intent, learning model, actuator confirmation, pending commands, control status and faults.

Keep stable unique-ID selection through entity-ID changes, exclude disabled/hidden or absent states, follow HA temperature units, clear unavailable/disconnected values and dispose registry subscriptions on detach.
Reuse existing HA APIs without changing panel.py, heating control or storage; leave controls and graphs for later stages.

Pass 196 Python tests and Edge regression scenarios covering room selection, state updates, ID rename, OFF pending versus null, unit display, unavailable/faults, invalid temperatures, reconnect, registry errors, cleanup, keyboard navigation and responsive widths; preserve external version 0.1.0 and pending live HA acceptance.
Connect dashboard and control-tab temperature apply, OFF/HEAT/AUTO and HOME/AWAY controls to the selected registered Climate's existing HA services.

Preserve typed temperature drafts during pushed state updates, respect entity bounds/steps and HA units, block unavailable/duplicate requests, report service rejection or 15-second response timeout without automatic retry, and keep displayed state based on HA reports.

Pass 196 Python tests plus Edge service-target, renamed-ID, range/empty-input, busy guard, failure recovery, timeout, Fahrenheit payload, non-optimistic display, both control surfaces and responsive layout checks.
Preserve existing heater/controller logic and external version 0.1.0; graphs and real HA/physical control acceptance remain pending.
Connect dashboard and history-tab plots to full-attribute HA Climate recorder history for indoor/target temperature and confirmed heater ON intervals over 6/24 hours.

Render responsive sample-held step lines with unavailable gaps, known/unknown heater bands, pointer/touch details and HA timezone labels; refresh visible graph tabs every 60 seconds and expose manual refresh.

Decode compressed and ordinary states, retain initial range state, collapse redundant records, discard stale room/period responses, bound response waits and distinguish missing history from query failures.

Pass 196 Python tests and two Edge regression suites including history parsing/gaps/seed, intervals, range changes, stale-response races, empty/error recovery, disconnect cleanup and responsive chart widths.
Preserve external version 0.1.0 and controller behavior; learning/peak comparison UI and live HA Recorder acceptance remain pending.
Display the most recently completed cycle's actual Peak, OFF/Peak/completion timestamps and independently stored existing/curve predicted Peaks and signed errors.
Attach model confidence only when the retained OFF forecast and completed comparison have the same valid OFF timestamp; keep newer-cycle forecasts separate and represent missing values as unknown.

Convert nested Celsius diagnostics to HA Fahrenheit display using absolute-temperature versus delta conversion; preserve legacy results without timestamps and identify unavailable entries' data as historical.

Pass 196 Python tests and three Edge suites covering cycle identity, unit conversion, missing forecasts, legacy/zero/invalid data, room switching and responsive comparison tables; preserve external 0.1.0 and existing controller/storage behavior.

Register a permission-checked read-only WebSocket API for detached committed Current/Long-term bucket snapshots, confidence and accepted/rejected cycle counts without database writes or predictor calls.

Connect dashboard and learning-tab plots for Cold/Warm/Predictive Warm/Cooling using actual five-minute temperature deltas, correct ON/Peak time origins, zero/gap preservation and Fahrenheit delta scaling.
Show per-layer confidence, cycle counts and pointer/touch bucket evidence/promotion details; support refresh, empty/unavailable/error states, stale-response isolation and responsive layouts.

Pass 203 Python tests and four Edge suites covering permission/ownership, snapshot immutability, recency confidence, separate layers, long-term-only data, units, races, cleanup and existing state/control/history/cycle regression checks.
Preserve external version 0.1.0 and heating/learning/storage behavior; live HA API/frontend acceptance remains pending.
Connect dashboard/control learning-model and prediction-policy selectors to existing Select services using exact registry ownership/config-entry/unique-ID matching and current renamed entity IDs.
Keep reported HA selection, supported-option validation, missing/unavailable guards, shared command locking, timeout/error handling and temperature draft preservation.

Pass 203 Python tests and four Edge suites including both selector surfaces, all prediction options, renamed targets, wrong-platform/hidden exclusion, room isolation and service rejection; inspect desktop/mobile layout. Live HA acceptance remains pending; external version stays 0.1.0.
Rename the Korean existing-model display label to basic learning in the sidebar, HA Select translation and README; preserve internal existing option and behavior.
Remove the unknown-selection placeholder from healthy model/policy dropdowns while preserving unavailable/unknown-state guidance and selectable first options; verify with the Edge control suite.

Apply the approved HA-style thermostat layout to both control surfaces with an interactive temperature arc, large endpoint handle, current temperature, mode/preset controls and collapsible learning settings.

Commit arc gestures once on release via existing Climate services, respect reported bounds/steps/units, roll back cancellation and isolate changed room/connection/unit contexts; retain numeric input and explicit apply for keyboard and fine adjustments.

Pass four Edge regression suites with arc gesture/cancellation checks and responsive layouts; scroll history into view before pointer testing after the larger card layout. Preserve controller and external version.

Remove duplicate current/target temperature and mode/preset summaries above the dashboard thermostat; keep the arc and controls as the single presentation and verify state/unit/unavailable behavior through the visible controls.
Show room-owned diagnostic sensor values and a selector-driven numeric history chart below the prediction/control diagnostics, preserving each sensor's reported unit.

Discover graphable sensors with full-attribute Recorder history; exclude enum/timestamp, hidden/disabled, foreign-entry and history-empty sensors from the selector. Support 6/24h, refresh/60-second lifecycle, step-held values, zero/gaps/unit changes, stale-response isolation and responsive pointer/touch plots.

Pass five Edge suites including numeric-history filtering, metric units, zero/gaps/start seed, periods, failure/retry and disconnect/reconnect; inspect the combined dashboard. Preserve controller, sensor definitions and external version.
Expose actual basic/curve OFF-response trajectories with wall-clock sample time, Celsius baseline and per-used-model accepted-cycle evidence; preserve heating decisions.

Overlay dashed live 'if switched OFF now' residual forecast on history only with confirmed heater ON, at least one valid cycle and a valid recent trajectory; show peak/confidence, future-only forecast region and Celsius/Fahrenheit conversion without extending measured values into the future.
Pass 203 Python tests and five Edge suites including sample timestamp semantics, zero-cycle/OFF/missing/stale forecast suppression and unit conversion; preserve external version.

Automatically version the sidebar module URL with a SHA-256 content fingerprint computed off the event loop; retain the static route and external integration version. Verify registration uses the actual file digest and remains idempotent/retryable.

Replace editable temperature inputs with read-only displays and remove Apply buttons on both thermostat surfaces. Commit +/- changes immediately and arc gestures once on release through existing Climate services.

Honor entity bounds/steps/units, disable bound and busy/unavailable controls, and restore HA-reported temperature after failed requests; pass five Edge suites including immediate dispatch, input/apply absence, bounds and rejection recovery.
